role: HRV deep-dive page of the comprehensive recovery PDF (time domain, frequency domain, nonlinear, ANS indexes, last-7 trend), the shared deep-dive drawing primitives (section title, subsection heading, auto-paginating wrapped text, metric-with-explanation block), and the interpretation strings used by the sleep/training/vitals deep-dive sections in DeepDiveReportRenderer+Body.swift.
types: DeepDiveReportRenderer.DeepDiveMetric: struct — one metric row as data (name, value, explanation, optional interpretation)
DeepDiveReportRenderer: extension — drawing and interpretation members
toplevel: File-scope private free functions (banded, bandedAscending, *Row builders, interpret* helpers, wrappedTextAttributes, metricExplanationHeight, vitalsConcerns, lastSevenTrendText) are listed as units. No globals or stored state. Every displayed string goes through String(localized:bundle: LanguageManager.appBundle) except hard-coded metric names RMSSD, SDNN, pNN50, SDSD, SD1/SD2 (Poincaré), DFA α2 and the HRSS-like unit suffixes in format strings.

units.does: Draws the HRV deep-dive: section title, then time-domain, frequency-domain, nonlinear and ANS subsections, then the last-7-session trend built only from sessions other than this one that started before it (newest first); returns the final y.

Draws the "Time Domain Metrics" subsection: reserves 80pt (page break if needed), draws the heading, then one metric block per row from timeDomainRows(result:) (RMSSD, SDNN, Mean RR/HR, pNN50, SDSD, optional triangular index; estimated ones marked and not read).

branches.effect: draws each row via drawMetricWithExplanation, threading y; rows absent (nil triangular index) were already dropped by compactMap

units.does: Draws the "Frequency Domain Metrics" subsection with an intro paragraph and one block per frequency row.

branches.effect: returns yPosition unchanged — the whole subsection (heading included) is omitted silently; otherwise draws it
draws each row block, threading y

units.does: Draws the "Nonlinear Dynamics" subsection: 80pt reserve, heading, an explanatory paragraph framing nonlinear metrics as context not a verdict, then each row from nonlinearRows(result:) (SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 — marked and not read when estimated —, optional DFA α1/α2, sample and approximate entropy).

branches.effect: draws each row block, threading y

units.does: Builds the nonlinear metric rows in order SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 (each through estimable: marked as an estimate with no reading when the result says so), DFA α1, DFA α2, sample entropy, approximate entropy, dropping the optional ones that are nil.

Builds the Sample Entropy row (value %.3f) with explanation (typical 0.8–2.0 in sleep) and banded interpretation: >1.0 "Higher complexity", >0.5 "Moderate complexity", else "Lower — more regular than usual".

branches.effect: returns nil so the row is omitted; otherwise returns the row

units.does: Draws the "Autonomic Nervous System Indexes" subsection from result.ansMetrics: 80pt reserve, heading, then stress index, PNS, SNS, HRV readiness and HRV-derived respiration rows that exist.

branches.effect: returns yPosition unchanged; the subsection is omitted
draws each row block, threading y

units.does: Draws the "Last-7-Session Trend" paragraph: keeps up to 7 overnight sessions reliable for HRV aggregates from the (already earlier, newest-first) list, takes their RMSSDs, runs TrendVerdict.evaluate on log scale over those readings plus tonight, and draws text comparing tonight with the arithmetic mean of those sessions.

branches.cond: fewer than 3 of those sessions have an RMSSD
branches.effect: returns yPosition+10 and draws nothing (no trend section); otherwise draws heading and paragraph and returns y+10

units.does: Draws a 16pt bold primary-colour section title in a 22pt-high box across the content width, a 0.5pt underline 24pt below, and returns underline y + 8.
Draws an 11pt semibold dark-gray subsection heading at the left margin and returns y + 16 (pageRect unused).

Measures text in the chosen TextStyle at contentWidth, reserves the whole block height (capped at one page of usable height) via ensureSpace so it starts on a new page when it does not fit, draws it, and returns y below it plus 4pt.
Returns min(height, page height − top margin − bottom margin − 20): the space a block requests so it moves whole to a new page unless it is taller than a page.

Draws one metric block. Builds the explanation and (optional) interpretation as attributed text and measures both at contentWidth−8 with the attributes they are drawn with; reserves 15 + explanation + 6 + interpretation + 4 pt (capped at a page) via ensureSpace; then draws name+value, the explanation and the wrapped interpretation at their full heights; returns y + 4.

branches.effect: draws the wrapped interpretation at its measured height; otherwise skips it

units.does: Draws the metric name (10pt semibold black) at left margin+4 and the value (10pt monospaced bold primary colour) 8pt after the measured name width on the same line; returns y + 15.
Draws a pre-measured attributed block at margin+4, contentWidth−8 wide and `height` tall; returns y + height.
Returns a deep-sleep interpretation string from percentage and minutes.

branches.effect: "Moderate — could benefit from more deep sleep…"; otherwise "Low deep sleep — physical recovery may be compromised"

units.does: Returns a REM-sleep interpretation string from percentage and minutes.

branches.effect: "Moderate — consider extending sleep…"; otherwise "Low REM — skill learning and emotional processing may be impaired"

units.does: Returns a CTL (fitness) band label using thresholds >64 / >45 / >26 / >13; the comment (lines 358-361) says the thresholds are scaled ×0.64 to match the Banister-TRIMP factor, without naming the unscaled bands.

branches.effect: "Very high fitness — serious endurance athlete level"
"Building fitness — keep consistent"; otherwise "Low fitness base…"

units.does: Returns an ATL-vs-CTL descriptive label.

branches.effect: "Fatigue exceeds fitness — productive training zone if temporary"; otherwise "Fatigue below fitness — recovering or tapering"

units.does: Returns a TSB (form) band label. The fatigue band starts below TrainingAdviceGate.heavyFatigueTSB (−15), the advice gate's heavy-fatigue line the holistic report's Form row also uses.

branches.effect: "Fatigued — productive overload zone if planned"; otherwise "Deeply fatigued — significant high strain, rest recommended"

units.does: Returns "<band label>: <band detail>" for an ACWR using ACWRBand(ratio:) (same five bands as the Training Load screen).
Returns a VO2max band label.

branches.effect: "Fair — average range"; otherwise the "aerobic capacity has room to grow" CTL-vs-VO2max framing

units.does: Builds the combined-vitals paragraph from the list of flagged vitals (respiratory rate above baseline band, wrist temp above +0.3°C, SpO2 < 95); with none flagged, vitalsWithinRangeSentence.

branches.effect: "Multiple vitals are above your usual range (…). Your recovery score already reflects them…"
"One vital is flagged (…)… if it persists for 2+ nights, it warrants attention…"; with zero concerns, vitalsWithinRangeSentence

units.does: Returns the text of the first (threshold, text) pair whose threshold the value strictly exceeds, scanning top-down; else the fallback.

branches.cond: value > threshold for a case (in order)
branches.effect: returns that case text; if none matches returns fallback

units.does: Returns the text of the first (threshold, text) pair whose threshold the value is strictly below, scanning in order; else the fallback.

branches.cond: value < threshold for a case (in order)
branches.effect: returns that case text; if none matches returns fallback

units.does: Builds time-domain rows RMSSD, SDNN, Mean RR/HR, pNN50, SDSD, triangular index (dropped when nil); SDNN, pNN50 and SDSD go through estimable, so an estimate is marked and not read against bands.
Returns the metric row unchanged when `result` does not mark `estimated`; otherwise a copy with the value marked '(estimate)' (markingEstimate) and no interpretation.
Builds the RMSSD row (%.1f ms) with an explanation that depends on whether the session carries raw RR points, and a plain band interpretation.

branches.effect: ?? true → hasRawRR false (treated as summary import)
explanation mentions the 5-minute analysis window; otherwise says the value was imported as a summary with no beat-to-beat intervals

units.does: Builds the SDNN row (%.1f ms) with explanation and band interpretation.
Builds the "Mean RR / Mean HR" row ("%.1f ms / %.0f bpm") with explanation and HR band interpretation.
Builds the pNN50 row (%.1f%%) with explanation (>20% strong vagal tone, <5% reduced) and band interpretation.
Builds the SDSD row (%.1f ms) with explanation and no interpretation.
Builds the HRV Triangular Index row with interpretation >20 "Above 20", >10 "Moderate", else "Below 10…".

branches.effect: returns nil (row omitted); otherwise the row

units.does: Builds frequency rows VLF, LF, HF, LF/HF, total power, normalized units, dropping nil ones.
Builds the VLF row (%.0f ms²) with interpretation >500 "Above 500 ms²", >100 "Moderate VLF", else "Low VLF…".

branches.effect: returns nil (row omitted, e.g. window under 10 min); otherwise the row

units.does: Builds the LF row (%.0f ms²) with explanation and no interpretation.
Builds the HF row (%.0f ms²) with interpretation >300 strong, >100 moderate, else low HF.
Builds the LF/HF ratio row (%.2f) with interpretation <1.0 parasympathetic-dominant, <2.5 balanced, else sympathetic-leaning.

branches.effect: returns nil (row omitted); otherwise the row

units.does: Builds the Total Power row (%.0f ms²); explanation states VLF+LF+HF when VLF exists, else LF+HF with VLF excluded; interpretation >2000 strong, >500 moderate, else low.

branches.effect: explanation "Sum of VLF + LF + HF…"; otherwise "Sum of LF + HF… VLF requires a 10+ minute window"

units.does: Builds the Normalized Units row "LF: x% / HF: y%" with interpretation HF-dominant when hfNu > 50 else LF-dominant.

branches.effect: "HF-dominant — parasympathetic tone strong…"; otherwise "LF-dominant — some sympathetic co-activation present"

units.does: Builds the SD1 (Poincaré) row (%.1f ms) with explanation, no interpretation.
Builds the SD2 (Poincaré) row (%.1f ms) with explanation, no interpretation.
Builds the SD1/SD2 ratio row (%.3f) with interpretation "0.3 or higher" when ratio >= 0.3 else "Below 0.3 — lower than typical during sleep".
Builds the DFA α1 row (%.3f) with reference-range explanation (0.75–1.0) and band interpretation.
Builds the DFA α2 row (%.3f) with explanation, no interpretation.
Builds the Approximate Entropy row (%.3f) with explanation, no interpretation.
Builds ANS rows stress index, PNS, SNS, HRV readiness, respiration rate, dropping nil ones.
Builds the Baevsky Stress Index row (%.1f) with interpretation via HRVThresholds (<100 low, <150 normal, <200 elevated, else high).
Builds the PNS Index row (%+.2f) with interpretation >1 excellent, >0 above average, >-1 below average, else low.
Builds the SNS Index row (%+.2f) with interpretation <-1 very low, <0 low, <1 moderately elevated, else elevated.
Builds the HRV Readiness row ("%.1f / 10") with explanation and a three-band interpretation.

branches.effect: long "High readiness — strong underlying capacity… check your Recovery score before going hard." string
"Moderate readiness — listen to your body"; otherwise "Low readiness — prioritize recovery today"

units.does: Builds the HRV-derived respiration rate row (formatted br/min) with interpretation from respirationRateInterpretation (<16 normal, 16–18 slightly elevated, >18 elevated — the line the explanation calls unusual).
Respiration-rate interpretation: < 16 'Normal range for rest/sleep', ≤ 18 'Slightly elevated', above 18 'Elevated — context-sensitive…'.

Builds the last-N-sessions paragraph: tonight RMSSD, signed difference from the arithmetic mean of `recent`, N and the mean, a note that this short window differs from the 60-day score baseline, and a direction sentence from the shared TrendVerdict movement.
Returns attributes for the deep-dive wrapped text: word-wrapping paragraph style with lineSpacing 1.5, plus 8.5pt gray (explanation) or 9pt dark gray (body).
The explanation as 8.5pt grey word-wrapped text with 1pt line spacing and the reading-direction paragraph style.
The interpretation as '<bullet> text' in 8.5pt medium dark grey, word-wrapped, so a long or translated interpretation keeps its last sentence.
ceil of the attributed text's bounding height at `width` (usesLineFragmentOrigin + usesFontLeading).
Returns the RMSSD band label ("Above 80 ms", "50–80 ms", "30–50 ms", "15–30 ms", "Below 15 ms"); the session parameter is unused.
Returns the SDNN band label.
Returns the mean-HR band label.

branches.effect: "60–70 bpm"; otherwise "Above 70 bpm during sleep — elevated…"

units.does: Returns the pNN50 band label.
Returns the DFA α1 label relative to the 0.75–1.0 reference range.

No-concern sentence: "Respiratory rate, wrist temperature and blood oxygen are within your usual ranges." only when a respiratory rate with a baseline, a wrist-temperature deviation and SpO2 were all present; otherwise "Every vital measured last night is within your usual range. No systemic stress flagged."

branches.cond: any of RR baseline, RR, wrist temperature, SpO2 missing
branches.effect: the 'every vital measured' sentence; else the all-three sentence

units.does: Lists flagged vitals: respiratory rate more than 1.0 br/min above its baseline, wrist temperature deviation above +0.3°C, SpO2 below RecoveryVitals.concerningSpO2Below (95%).

branches.cond: respiratoryRate and baseline both present and rr − baseline > respiratoryRateBandBreathsPerMin (1.0)
branches.effect: appends "respiratory rate outside your baseline band"; missing baseline → not checked
appends "wrist temperature outside your normal band"
